payload.subject: One automation, 20+ new appointments a month
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Here's an unpopular opinion.


Your leads aren't going cold because they weren't interested.


They're going cold because nobody got back to them fast enough.


Most service businesses check their inbox in batches — a few times a day, if that.


The AI Growth Engine works the opposite way.


It replies the second a lead comes in, day or night, then keeps following up until they book or say no.


One independent service business we worked with wasn't losing leads on purpose.


They were just buried in everything else the business needed that day.


Once follow-up ran on its own instead of waiting on a free moment, the appointments that used to slip through started landing on the calendar instead.


That's the same system built to get a business like yours 20-40 new client appointments a month.


This works best if you already have a way to handle new clients once they book.


If you're not ready to take on more work yet, this one's not for you.
